title: PROSpect 研究发现俯卧位与高频振荡通气对早期中重度儿童急性呼吸窘迫综合征无效
originalTitle: [Articles] Prone positioning and high-frequency oscillatory ventilation in early paediatric acute respiratory distress syndrome (PROSpect): an international, two-by-two factorial, response-adaptive, phase 3, randomised controlled trial
summary: PROSpect 研究发现俯卧位与高频振荡通气对早期中重度儿童急性呼吸窘迫综合征无效。该国际多中心、随机对照试验纳入XXX名患者，结果显示这两种通气策略未能显著提高呼吸机自由天数。
author: Martha A Q Curley, Martin C J Kneyber, Ira M Cheifetz, Michele Kong, Sidharth Mahapatra, Adam J Schwarz, Suwannee Phumeetham, Katherine Irby, Natalie Napolitano, Onella S Dawkins-Henry, Emily E Birch, Corrine F Elliott, Lindsay R Berry, Kevin J Downes, Aruna Natarajan, Michelle A Detry, Kert Viele, Todd L Graves, Michael Matthay, Lisa A Asaro, David Wypij, PROSpect Study Investigators, Paediatric Acute Lung Injury and Sepsis Investigators Network
